description: This file defines a web-based configuration page for VoIP SIP Advanced Service Provider settings. It includes PHP code for server-side logic, HTML for structure, embedded JavaScript for client-side interactions, and references several included PHP files for headers, navigation, and utility functions. The page enables users to view and modify SIP-related settings such as call waiting, conferencing, hold, caller ID, DSCP priorities, and network disconnect options.

methods.name: Dm_data_get
methods.description: Returns an array of configuration values related to VoIP SIP features, fetched using the getStr() function for specific device parameters.
